title: More of the work, job by job.
intro: Hotels, restaurants, shops, workplaces and homes we have papered and decorated, beyond the case studies above. Each is shown with our own site photographs. Private homes are named by area only.
note: Photographs were taken on site by us or our installation team; some show work in progress. Hotel and business names appear with the owner's approval; private clients are never named.

items.name: Waldorf Astoria London Admiralty Arch
items.text: Wall preparation, lining and wallpapering in panelled guest suites and corridors before opening, including a blue-grey leaf-trail stripe.

items.name: London Marriott Hotel Canary Wharf
items.text: A large textured mural of historic dock warehouses hung along a ground-floor corridor, and a lobby feature wall stripped and prepared.

items.name: Heythrop Park
items.text: Passenger lift car interiors refinished in architectural film, linen texture above dark wood grain, fitted at night over several visits.

items.name: A hotel in London

items.name: A hotel function floor

items.name: The Marylebone

items.name: The Lensbury, Teddington

items.name: Hilton London Hyde Park
